description: This file contains unit tests for the HPACK header compression/decompression in HTTP/2, specifically testing round-trip encoding and decoding of header blocks with various input splitting strategies.

classes.name: HpackRoundTripTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the correctness of HPACK header encoding and decoding with different input split strategies.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting small header table sizes to test eviction.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Performs a round-trip test of header encoding and decoding, verifying the decoded headers match the original.

methods.name: SampleExponential
methods.description: Generates a sample size based on an exponential distribution, used for randomized testing.
